subject: general
question: What is the primary function of an alternator in a modern vehicle?

options.text: Storing electrical energy for later use
Supplying power directly to the spark plugs
Generating Alternating Current (AC) and converting it into Direct Current (DC)

solution:
The correct answer is __Generating Alternating Current (AC) and converting it into Direct Current (DC)__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Alternator__ is a crucial component in modern vehicles.
 
• Its primary function is to generate electrical power to charge the battery and run the electrical system when the engine is running.
 
• It converts mechanical energy from the engine into electrical energy.
 
• The alternator produces Alternating Current (AC), which is then converted into Direct Current (DC) using a rectifier for use by the vehicle’s electrical components.
 
• Without a functioning alternator, the battery would not stay charged, and the vehicle would eventually lose power.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Battery:**

 
 
• The battery stores electrical energy for starting the engine and powering electrical components when the engine is off.
 
• It works in conjunction with the alternator to maintain the vehicle's electrical system.
 
 
 
• **Starter Motor:**
 
 
• The starter motor uses electrical energy from the battery to start the engine by turning the crankshaft.
 
• It operates only during the ignition process.
 
 
 
• **Voltage Regulator:**
 
 
• The voltage regulator ensures that the alternator produces a consistent voltage level suitable for the vehicle’s electrical system.
 
• It prevents overcharging or undercharging of the battery.
